name: Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic
tagline: Sikafloor-400 N Elastic is a one-component, UV resistant, highly elastic, moisture curing polyurethane waterproof membrane.
summary: Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic is a one part, highly elastic, solvent containing, UV resistant, coloured, moisture curing polyurethane resin coating.
metaDescription: Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic is a one part, highly elastic, solvent containing, UV resistant, coloured, moisture curing polyurethane resin coating.
usage: Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic is used for:
Exposed roof decks terraces, gutters, flashings, walls

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text:
BRANZ Test Report: DC11037-001: AS4654.1 2012: Meets requirements as a Class II Membrane: Heavy Duty System
Synthetic resin screed material for floor screeds according to EN 13813:2002, Declaration of Performance 0208050100100000011008, certified by notified factory production control body 0921 and provided with the CE mark
Coating for concrete protection according to EN 1504-2:2004, Declaration of Performance 0208050100100000011008, certified by notified factory production control body 0921 and provided with the CE mark
Approval for “Ground Water Protection System”, Z-59.12-4, DIBt, Germany, July 2008.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The packaging must be stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging, in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C.

items.label: Temperature resistance
items.text:
Exposure* | Dry heat
Permanent | +50 °C
Short-term max. 7d | +80 °C
Short-term max. 8h | +100 °C
*No simultaneous chemical and mechanical exposure.

items.label: Chemical resistance
items.text: Resistant to many chemicals. Contact Sika technical service. Attention: Wine, coffee, some leaves and flower petals etc. may cause surface discolouration. This will have no effect on the product performance and durability.

items.label: Dew point
items.text: Beware of condensation! The substrate and uncured floor must be at least 3 °C above dew point to reduce the risk of condensation or blooming on the floor finish.

items.label: Substrate moisture content
items.text:
< 4 % pbw moisture content. Test method: Sika®-Tramex meter, CM - measurement or Oven-dry-method. No rising moisture according to ASTM (Polyethylene sheet).
Use Sikafloor 161 for moisture to 6%pbw

items.label: Pot Life
items.text: The material in opened containers should be applied immediately. With open containers surface film formation will happen within 1-2 hours. High temperatures and high air humidity will accelerate curing significantly.

items.label: Curing time
items.text:
Before overcoating Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic allow:
Substrate temperature | Minimum | Maximum
+10 °C | 36 hours | 5 days
+20 °C | 24 hours | 3 days
+30 °C | 16 hours | 2 days
Times are approximate and will be affected by changing ambient conditions particularly temperature and relative humidity.

items.label: Applied product ready for use
items.text:
Temperature (r.h. 50%) | Rain resistant | Foot traffic | Full cure
+10 °C | ~15 hours | ~1 - 2 days* | ~7 - 14 days*
+20 °C | ~5 hours | ~6 - 24 hours* | ~5 - 9 days*
+30 °C | ~3 hours | ~4 - 18 hours* | ~3 - 5 days*
*Strongly influenced by layer thickness Note: Times are approximate and will be affected by changing ambient conditions

items.label: MIXING
items.text:
Prior to use stir Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic mechanically for 3 minutes. If required the Thinner C or Extender T should be added into the Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic until a uniform mix has been achieved. Over mixing must be avoided to minimise air entrainment.
Mixing Tools:
Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic must be thoroughly mixed using a low speed electric stirrer (300 - 400 rpm) or other suitable equipment.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text: Prior to application, confirm substrate moisture content, relative humidity and dew point. As a primer Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic is diluted by 10% with Thinner C, applied by brush, roller or squeegee and as a coating Sikafloor®-400 N Elastic is poured and spread evenly with a trowel.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with Thinner C immediately after use. Hardened and/or cured material can only be removed mechanically.
